items.q: So I got these different guys like Colt Bill Harrison -- put these musicians together

ctx.x: Wilmington -- where they sent me to listen to the band. I took a -- what was going on with the band and with Louie. When I came back -- You must remember, I never worked with Louie until -- I never had any experience until he came to rehearsal that day after he came off his vacation with two weeks in Chicago. He had been out around Chicago on his vacation. Now Joe asked me to build him this band. So I got these different guys like Colt Bill Harrison -- put these musicians together -- it was pretty good.
